verdict.rationale: Relay's docs say it automatically syncs detailed transaction data, receipts and categorizations into QuickBooks Online and Xero, which reduces manual journal entries. However, the evidence describes only a one-way push into accounting software, with no claim that the sync is real-time or that changes flow back from the ledger. Missing for 10: evidence of bidirectional sync, an explicit real-time sync guarantee, support for full ERP systems beyond QBO/Xero, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sync reliability.
